rules.rule: The body states only what the user attested; an unconfirmed inference is an open question
must: The body states attested facts only
concluded but the user did not confirm never enters it
A guess of your own that the user never confirmed is `deferred`

rules.rule: Nothing is written before the caller's confirmation; no separate bank-this prompt
must: On discovery: note the candidate in the conversation; no write
never a separate step, a separate question, or a "bank this\?" prompt
On confirmation: write each confirmed fact to `<kb>/_inbox\.md`

rules.rule: A confirmed fact lands in the inbox, never straight on a topic page
must: Never to a topic page or a category invented at this moment

rules.rule: A question may deepen a subject the interview opened, never open a new one
must: never open a new one
route it to `_open-questions\.md` marked `deferred` and move on immediately\. Never re-ask

rules.rule: Writes nowhere outside the kb folder and never runs git
must: Must not: run `git`
write outside the `kb` folder, ever

rules.rule: Refuses to write into a kb folder a Confluence sync manages
must: must \*\*not\*\* be managed by a Confluence sync
refuse to write and say why

rules.rule: Filing appends to the existing page; never splits a page for size; one fact never earns a page
must: Append by default
Never split a page to fix its size
A single fact never earns a page

rules.rule: File and restructure show the moves and wait for confirmation before touching a file
must: get confirmation before touching anything
confirm it first, then repair every reference

rules.rule: A bare capture attests to the session, never an inferred SRD id; no invented gap id
must: do not infer an id from the conversation to fill the slot
`Attested session
omit the segment rather than inventing a number

rules.rule: An unknown is never filed as a documentation gap
must: An unknown is \*\*never\*\* filed as a documentation gap

rules.rule: Report one pointer line per page with its count, never the facts
must: One pointer line per page touched, with its count
Never what the facts say

rules.rule: The gate rejects an absolute kb path
must: an absolute path is invalid
